sloka: पञ्चना या तु लब्धा मे तां त्वम् निस्तर्तुमिच्छसि ।अनया वृत्तसादिन्या कैकेय्याऽभिप्रचोदितः ॥२-३४-३७॥
transliteration: pañcanā yā tu labdhā me tāṁ tvam nistartumicchasi ।anayā vṛttasādinyā kaikeyyā'bhipracoditaḥ ॥2-34-37॥

translations.english: Instigated by this Kaikeyi, the destroyer of traditions (of the race) I have been deceived for which you wish to pay.
